items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: he had George Wetland on drums that he had left in Chicago and Jess Stacy and Pat Patterson that was the band that Paul wanted to put together

ctx.x: his last regular job was though

yeah in 1934 at Harry's New York Ball that was his last band in fact right about a year before Paul died he came down to New Orleans the owner of the Blue Note gave Paul permission to come pick up a band and he came down to New Orleans and I even went around with him and he had Santo on trombone he had Fasola on clarinet he had Lester Boucher on tenor and himself would be on trumpet and he had George Wetland on drums that he had left in Chicago and Jess Stacy and Pat Patterson that was the band that Paul wanted…
the exact date did you give the date of his death about?
